title: ITIN letter and stage emails: clients with the app get one notice, not an email on top
text: When the IRS ITIN approval letter is uploaded, the client now gets a portal chat message and a notification; an email goes out only as the usual "you have an unread message" reminder, not straight away. Milestone emails sent when a case moves stage, for every service, are now skipped for a client who has the app, because the push notification already reached them. The "Your ITIN is ready" notice can now be dismissed.
points: In the ITIN workspace the three upload boxes show a Document type list that follows the Storage rule, with the right type already selected.
Staff see "client notified" only when the message really went out; if the last step did not finish an amber warning shows instead of a green tick.
Emails that need the client to act, such as signing the SS-4, are unchanged.
